verified_metadata.title: A Human-AI Theorem Connecting Spontaneous and Field-Induced Mechanisms of Collective Behavior in One Dimension
verified_metadata.abstract: Can an artificial intelligence (AI) generate a scientific hypothesis outside a human collaborator's active hypothesis space (AHS), and can human-AI research be organized to make such breakthroughs more likely? We document such a case while proving a theorem that connects two basic organizing mechanisms of statistical physics: collective behavior arising in zero field from competing interactions and that induced or controlled by an external field. A zero-field $O(n)$-vector open chain with arbitrary inhomogeneous nearest- and next-nearest-neighbor interaction functions $U_i(S_i\cdot{S}_{i+1})$ and $V_i(S_i\cdot{S}_{i+2})$ is microscopically, via a temperature-independent mapping at the Hamiltonian level, equivalent to a simpler $O(n)$ open chain with nearest-neighbor interaction $V_i(\boldsymbol\sigma_i\cdot\boldsymbol\sigma_{i+1})$ and axial single-spin potential $U_i(\sigma_i^z)$ for every integer $n\ge1$ and every system size $L\ge1$. The homogeneous linear specialization maps the foundational frustrated $J_1$-$J_2$ model onto the canonical $J$-$h$ field model---with $n=1,2,3$ being the Ising, XY, and Heisenberg classical spin models, respectively; the theorem resolved a longstanding challenge for $n=3$ published in 1990. Its proof was done with an AI-synthesized recursive Householder moving frame and understood via a human-recognized hidden reciprocity. An analogous theorem holds when the continuous $O(n)$ spins are replaced by the $q$-state Potts spins, implying a closed-form exact solution of the $J_1$-$J_2$ standard Potts open chain for every $q\ge2$ and every $L\ge1$. The emergence of these theorems from a human-AI co-development framework suggests that sustained AI involvement throughout a systematic research program may incubate autonomous scientific breakthroughs and make aspects of the discovery process experimentally testable.

cover.selection_rationale: Source Figures 1–3 are dense conceptual AHS/provenance diagrams; the finite-open-chain theorem and boundary condition are clearer as text and equations at card size.
cover.abstract_text: A recursive Householder frame maps every finite open O(n) chain with arbitrary site-dependent range-two interactions to a range-one chain while preserving energy and measure. A staggered bond map gives the analogous q-state Potts result. Periodic closure imposes an extra constraint; AI-discovery claims are a documented case study, not a general causal finding.

sections.title: 作者信息
paragraphs: Weiguo Yin（布鲁克海文国家实验室）。本文在 2026-09-02 官方 cond-mat New 列表中以 v1 出现；这份卡片按修订后的 v2 全文（17 页）解释。v2 于 9 月 23 日上线，修正了边界条件、历史叙述和 AI 贡献归因（官方版本记录；v2 PDF pp1–2,5,11）。

sections.title: 研究问题
paragraphs: 一维竞争相互作用的零场 \(J_1\)–\(J_2\) 链能否在**每个有限开放链**上，直接改写成最近邻交换加轴向外场的链？文章给出比热力学极限的自由能等价更强的答案：构型双射同时保持能量和积分测度，而且允许相互作用随位置任意变化（v2 PDF pp3–5）。这里“自发”指零外场相互作用诱导的集体关联，不表示短程一维模型在有限温度自发破缺。

sections.title: 模型与方法
paragraphs: 原模型为 \(H=\sum_{i=1}^{L-1}U_i(S_i\cdot S_{i+1})+\sum_{i=1}^{L-2}V_i(S_i\cdot S_{i+2})\)，\(S_i\in S^{n-1}\)，\(n\ge1\)。固定单位矢量 \(\hat e\)，取满足 \(H(x)^T=H(x)\)、\(H(x)^TH(x)=I\)、\(H(x)\hat e=x\) 的 Householder 反射。令 \(G_1=H(S_1)\)、\(\sigma_i=G_i^TS_{i+1}\)、\(G_{i+1}=G_iH(\sigma_i)\)，保留 \(S_1\) 即得到可逐点逆转的变量变换（v2 p4 Eqs. 11–16）。

由反射的对称性，\(S_i\cdot S_{i+1}=\hat e\cdot\sigma_i\)，\(S_i\cdot S_{i+2}=\sigma_i\cdot\sigma_{i+1}\)。于是最近邻竞争项成为轴向单自旋势，次近邻项成为最近邻交换。每一步都是条件正交变换，保持球面测度；归一化测度下 \(Z_{\rm range\,2}^{\rm OBC}(L)=Z_{\rm range\,1}^{\rm OBC}(L-1)\)，非归一化时额外乘零场单自旋因子 \(\Omega_{n-1}\)（v2 pp4–5 Eqs. 17–21）。

sections.title: 核心定理与证据
paragraphs: 均匀线性特例 \(U_i(x)=-J_1x,\ V_i(x)=-J_2x\) 给 \(J=J_2,h=J_1\)：零场最近邻关联对应外场模型的磁化，原次近邻关联对应新链最近邻关联。非线性特例 \(U_i(x)=-hx+Dx^2\) 把轴向单离子各向异性 \(D(\sigma_i^z)^2\) 对应为双二次交换 \(D(S_i\cdot S_{i+1})^2\)；这些是经典开放链恒等式，不是量子链或材料实验的直接等价（v2 pp6–7 Eqs. 31–34）。
v2 特别补上周期限制：闭合环时双变量必须满足 \(\prod_{i=1}^LH(\sigma_i)\hat e=\hat e\)。因此无约束周期 \(J\)–\(h\) 链的**有限尺寸**配分函数未必等于原环链；有界有限程相互作用的热力学极限自由能密度才不受这个边界差别影响（v2 p5 Eq. 22）。

sections.title: 核心结果与证据
paragraphs: 对标准 \(q\) 态 Potts（\(q\ge2\)），暂把状态标为 \(\mathbb Z_q\)，取 \(b_i=s_i-s_{i+1}\pmod q\)、\(\tau_i=(-1)^ib_i\pmod q\)。保留首端态后，\(\delta_{s_i,s_{i+1}}=\delta_{\tau_i,0}\)、\(\delta_{s_i,s_{i+2}}=\delta_{\tau_i,\tau_{i+1}}\)，于是 \(Z_2(L)=qZ_1(L-1)\)（v2 pp7–8 Eqs. 35–45）。
均匀 \(J_1\)–\(J_2\) 特例在 \(L\ge2\) 可写成 \(q\mathbf b^TT^{L-2}\mathbf b\) 的二维转移矩阵式（v2 p8 Eqs. 46–47）；这是有限链的闭式表达。Potts 中所谓任意函数 \(U_i(d),V_i(d)\) 只在 \(d=0,1\) 上取值，等价于位点依赖线性耦合加常数。

sections.title: 有效性与局限
paragraphs: v2 对先例作了收紧：1984 年平面结果涉及周期转移积分，1990 年工作给出开放链有限配分函数对应；论文认为此前未展示完整构型双射及测度证明。作者还更正 v1 中 AI 已独立证明 \(n=3\) 的说法：较早的角度/二面角局部恒等式曾被过早称为完整证明，后续在人的 \(O(n)\) 提示下形成 Householder 构造；框架互易解释和不均匀推广来自人（v1 pp4,7–8；v2 pp5–6,10–11）。
论文把部分过程评为“9d” AI 贡献并提供对话记录 DOI；本卡只把它视作作者的单案例归因，未独立逐消息审计，也不能据此断定某种人机协作策略具有普遍或因果优势。

sections.title: 复现与资源
paragraphs: 独立小规模核对覆盖 O(n) 数百组配置、Potts 26,208 组配置及有限转移式，支持公式未见低维反例，但不能替代通用证明或穷尽先例检索。

sections.title: 阅读指南
paragraphs: 阅读建议先看 v2 pp3–5 的构造和周期警告，再看 pp7–8 的 Potts 证明，最后对照 pp10–13 的贡献边界。[v1 摘要](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00322v1)、[v2 PDF](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2609.00322v2)、[对话记录 DOI](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22718924)。
